description:
What the French official gazette printed about companies you already track, since a date.
Answers "did anything happen to these companies", "any news on X since my last check".

Up to 20 companies per call. Every 5 companies spend one unit of the rate
limit (30 per minute per address, rounded up per call), so pass them in ONE call rather than one call each.

Entries are filtered on the PUBLICATION date, not the date of the act (16 days apart at the median).
An empty list means nothing was published, not that nothing happened.

since.description: Publication date to look back to, ISO 8601. Defaults to 30 days ago.

siren.description: The companies to look at. One call for all of them, not one call each.

items.description: Nine-digit SIREN, spaces and dots accepted. A SIRET minus its last five digits.

name: get_french_company_announcements
title: What the gazette published recently
